title: Stopwatch
description: Interactive p5.js stopwatch simulation with start/stop and reset controls, displaying elapsed time in MM:SS.mmm format on an OLED-style display.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Stopwatch
Time Measurement
State Machine
User Interface
learningObjectives: Explain how a stopwatch computes elapsed time by subtracting a stored start timestamp from the current system time
Trace the transitions between the running and stopped states as the Start/Stop button toggles the timer, including how elapsed time is preserved across a pause
Convert a raw millisecond count into a formatted MM:SS.mmm display string using division and remainder operations
Explain why debounce protection is needed so a single button press does not register as multiple start/stop events
